verses.text: This is the message the LORD gave to Joel son of Pethuel.
Listen to this, you leaders! Pay attention, everyone who lives in the land! Has anything like this ever happened in your lifetime or in the time of your ancestors?
Tell your children about it. Let your children tell their children, and let their children tell the next generation.
What the swarming locusts left, the great locusts have eaten. What the great locusts left, the young locusts have eaten. What the young locusts left, the other locusts have eaten.
Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you wine drinkers! The sweet new wine has been snatched from your lips.
A nation has invaded my land, powerful and too many to count. Its teeth are like a lion's teeth, with the fangs of a lioness.
It has destroyed my grapevines and ruined my fig trees. It has stripped off their bark and thrown it away, leaving their branches white.
Mourn like a young woman dressed in rough cloth, grieving for the husband she married when she was young.
There is no more grain offering or drink offering for the house of the LORD. The priests who serve the LORD are mourning.
The fields are ruined. The ground is in mourning. The grain is destroyed, the new wine has dried up, and the olive oil has failed.
Despair, you farmers! Wail, you who grow grapes! Mourn for the wheat and the barley, because the harvest of the fields is lost.
The vine has dried up, and the fig tree has withered. The pomegranate, the palm, the apple tree, and all the trees of the field have dried up. Truly, people's joy has withered away.

Put on rough cloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you who serve at the altar! Come, spend the night in rough cloth, you who serve my God, because the grain offerings and drink offerings are kept from the house of your God.
Announce a holy fast. Call a special meeting. Gather the leaders and everyone who lives in the land to the house of the LORD your God, and cry out to the LORD.
What a terrible day! The day of the LORD is near. It will come like destruction from the Almighty.
Hasn't the food been cut off right before our eyes? Hasn't joy and gladness disappeared from the house of our God?
The seeds are shriveled beneath the clods of soil. The storehouses are in ruins. The barns have been torn down, because the grain has dried up.
How the animals groan! The herds of cattle wander around confused, because they have no pasture. Even the flocks of sheep are suffering.
LORD, I cry out to you, because fire has burned up the pastures in the wilderness, and flames have burned all the trees of the field.
Even the wild animals pant for you, because the streams of water have dried up, and fire has burned up the pastures in the wilderness.
